decisions.reason: Selecting SMD mounting for the JST-PH battery connector does not necessarily change its specified board placement, L-shaped orientation, hole clearance, or connector spacing.
The battery connector mounting type does not change the switched 5V sensor rail's voltage, converter, GPIO control, loads, or operating pattern.
The source decision applies to the JST-PH battery connector, while the candidate independently specifies JST-GH connectors for interboard connections.
Choosing an SMD battery connector does not itself alter the current board dimensions, USB-C position, mounting holes, aspect ratio, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The SMD mounting preference does not modify the existing component-sourceability policy or the USB-connector-specific availability and cost constraints.
